acceptance: SUCCESS is published only if all seven expected observations validate and all custody checks pass; status then is COMPLETED_AWAITING_FRESH_ACTUAL_RESULT_AUDIT, never proof or ledger acceptance. Any failure preserves partial logs and counters, launches no further call, and permits no retry.
authoritySeparation: This proposal grants no authority. Root first materializes this source and fills the literal operator SHA-256, then a fresh full non-author source/effect/resource audit plus two substantive votes, then a root adoption record requiring that the pending fresh actual-input audit has accepted the nine generated inputs, then an exact new AUTH. This source author approves nothing and no future audit file, hash or vote is read or invented here.

budgets.note: Per-call VM ExBudget::default() is the Aiken default, separate from these OS limits. No uninterruptible-death or transitive-CPU claim is made.

command.calls: Exactly seven sequential calls in K10-T1..T7 order, one attempt each, zero retries, launch intent counted before Popen.
command.contextPassing: Each 2649-byte context file is read with a bounded read, hash-checked, strict-UTF-8 decoded, exactly one trailing newline stripped if present, required single-line, and passed as exactly one argv element. No shell and no string evaluation.
command.forbidden: No --flat, --debug or any other guessed flag; no subprocess shell; no additional debug JSON mode.

custody: SHA-256 of all eleven pins (tool, data manifest, nine generated inputs), the staged read-only tool (mode 555) and all five operator files are checked before and after. Inputs under the local inputs directory must already be read-only staged by root. A wrong size or hash fails before any command.
explicitNonClaims: Local fabricated 2222../555.. outref/claimant, zero fee and builder-chosen expiry 1893456000000 (2030) are FABRICATED/UNBOUND; no ledger, fee, conservation, min-ADA, admission, wallet, signing or Preprod claim.
Local VM cpu/mem are not qualified node ledger ExUnits and support no fee or tx-fit claim.
Header parse and vkey matrix setup are Class-0 forgeable; no trusted ceremony is inferred.

All 20 UTxO families, ACTUS 277/18/32, DeFi 72 and general obligations, real recursion, private handoff, bounded multi-parent universal work and real Preprod remain open. No percentage of full compatibility.
generatedInputs: Nine files already generated once by the ordinary R2 adapter (exit 0, one attempt, no retry; source/input pins unchanged): script.hex, manifest.json and seven 2649-byte contexts, all pinned literally in AUTH-CANDIDATE.json. Their fresh actual data audit is PENDING and separate; this proposal does not freeze it as accepted or invent its future hash.
isolation: bwrap --unshare-all --die-with-parent --new-session --clearenv with only the tool read-only at /tool, the nine inputs read-only at /inputs, a fresh capture directory writable at /capture, minimal /dev, /proc and /tmp, and minimal environment. No network, stdlib/build/validators, wallet, host home, /usr mounts, keys, RNG, prover, LLVM or cargo.
negativeParser: Accept only exit exactly 1, empty stdout, and full-match stderr: blank line, Error, -----, the exact text 'the validator crashed / exited prematurely', Costs with positive integer cpu/memory, and at most one bounded Logs section with no unexplained trailing content. OutOfExError ('execution went over budget'), syntax/Miette errors, signals, timeouts and any other nonzero shape fail closed.
objective: Evaluate the actual already-compiled C2 mint wrapper with its genuine published proof/VK and raw PlutusV3 ScriptContext terms under the independently recomputed compiled policy 6a4b67e7d46dbada1b4f49dd324018324b60b13bebbeb6f33d9d59c1 already bound in the contexts; no old local a2 policy is substituted and no Env settle-A2 statement is blindly replaced.
positiveParser: Accept T1 only on exit 0, empty stderr, and stdout strict JSON with exactly result/cpu/mem, result exactly (con unit ()), and non-bool positive integer cpu/mem.
prerequisiteOrder: fresh actual-input audit accepts the nine generated inputs (currently PENDING)
root materializes this source, fills literal operator SHA, records source manifest
fresh full non-author source/effect/resource audit with two substantive votes AGREEs

only then propose FX1, signatures, claim consume/atomic settle, qualified ledger cost and real Preprod separately
